headline: Eagles All-Pro Lane Johnson retires, ending 14-season NFL career
summary: Eagles two-time All-Pro right tackle Lane Johnson announced his retirement Tuesday, ending a 14-year career spent entirely in Philadelphia.

headline: Eagles DC Vic Fangio: Number of snaps impacted defense against Rams, but have to finish
summary: The Eagles had a 20-10 lead over the Rams deep into the fourth quarter of last Sunday's game against the Rams, but they wound up losing when the Rams scored back-to-back touchdowns in the final four minutes of the game.
